bifrost: springboard/ui/src/call.rs (CallCenter, CallAction, Handle, CallEvent). No shell call UI, no audio routing, no SDK binding, no call directory. Adjacent: springboard/sdk/src/usernotif.rs, springboard/audiod/src/
summary: BifrOSt has a pure call-state model: outgoing and incoming calls, answer, end, hold, mute, DTMF validation, transactions and an event list for observers. Nothing shows the call on screen, routes audio, reaches apps through the SDK, or handles caller ID and blocking.

features.note: state and requests exist; no provider registration, no configuration object, no delegate callbacks into an app
an incoming call can be reported and answered in the model; no full-screen or banner call interface, no push delivery
a dialing call connects on report; transactions apply all-or-nothing; no start-call request path from apps

features.apple: End, DTMF, group, hold, mute, translate actions
features.note: end, hold, mute and DTMF are modelled; group and translate are missing; DTMF tones are not played
active calls and Added, Changed, Ended events are readable in-process; no SDK observer for apps and no cross-process delivery

features.apple: Preparing your app to be the default calling app

gaps: Call provider registration and configuration in the SDK
Incoming call screen and banner in the shell
Audio routing and DTMF tone output for calls
Active-call observation for apps over the SDK
